boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Caltech spaces for collaborative study, making, meetings, recreation, and performing arts, with student uses and access conditions verified through direct Institute sources.

cards.title: Meet in the Campus Living Room
cards.subtitle: Public lounge and student-activity hub
cards.notes: Use the large lounge for an informal meetup, then check the building’s club rooms or rehearsal spaces when your group needs a dedicated setup.
cards.short_summary: A central indoor gathering point with lounge, club, dining, retail, and rehearsal spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech states that the Hameetman Center features a large public lounge, student-club rooms, music rehearsal facilities, a multipurpose room, and a conference room.
cards.source_title: Campus Celebrates Opening of the Hameetman Center
cards.access_notes: The lounge is described as public, but individual club, conference, rehearsal, and multipurpose rooms may require scheduling or program access.

cards.title: Find the Room That Fits the Project
cards.subtitle: Club, publication, music, gaming, and screening rooms
cards.notes: Head to the south-housing basement when a team needs meeting, rehearsal, publication, shop, gaming, or movie-screening space.
cards.short_summary: A student-run cluster of specialized rooms beneath the south undergraduate houses.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s current catalog says the Student Activities Center contains student-government and publication workspaces, rehearsal and club rooms, a library, shop, and movie-screening room.
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of the south undergraduate housing complex and open for student use 24 hours a day; most rooms are open 24 hours.

cards.title: Prototype Beyond the Problem Set
cards.subtitle: Library makerspace on Caltech Hall’s first floor
cards.notes: Bring a fabrication or presentation idea here for 3D printing, poster production, technology loans, or hands-on crafting machinery.
cards.short_summary: A library makerspace combining digital fabrication, large-format output, lending, and DIY equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech identifies TechHub as a free library makerspace offering 3D printing, large-scale poster printing, technology lending, and DIY machines.
cards.access_notes: The cited event was internal. Routine equipment access, training, availability, and eligibility should be confirmed with TechHub staff before visiting.

cards.title: Choose Collaboration or Quiet
cards.subtitle: Caltech’s main library and group-study base
cards.notes: Reserve one of five group rooms for shared work, or move into a private study area when the conversation turns into individual focus.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library supports both collaborative sessions and independent concentration.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s current academic catalog calls Sherman Fairchild the main campus library and documents collaborative and private study areas, including five bookable group-study rooms.
cards.source_title: Education and Research | Caltech Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Usually open seven days a week into the evening. Entry and group-room reservations may require Caltech credentials; verify current library hours.

cards.title: Spread Out Around a Large Display
cards.subtitle: Ninth-floor collaboration and study space
cards.notes: Take a group here when diagrams, slides, or shared screens need more room; reserve Room 907 for a meeting or teaching session.
cards.short_summary: An upper-floor library space designed for flexible study and screen-based collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s current catalog describes the Caltech Hall ninth floor as a flexible collaboration and study space with large displays and Room 907 as bookable.
cards.source_title: Education and Research | Caltech Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Room 907 is bookable. Confirm current Caltech Hall entry rules, ninth-floor availability, and reservation procedures with the Library.

cards.title: Gather Around Community Programming
cards.subtitle: Center for Inclusion and Diversity lounge
cards.notes: Use the lounge for an eligible community gathering or program, and follow CCID’s booking process before planning exclusive group use.
cards.short_summary: A reservable gathering space connected to Caltech’s inclusion and cultural-exchange programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Caltech Center for Inclusion and Diversity directly provides a booking pathway for the CCID Lounge and CSS Common Area.
cards.access_notes: Booking is handled through CCID. Programs and support structures are available to the campus community, but room use remains subject to approval.

cards.title: Practice Without Taking Over a Lounge
cards.subtitle: Card-access rehearsal rooms at 305 South Hill Avenue
cards.notes: Request card access before your first visit, then use a practice room for solo or chamber work without displacing a scheduled coaching.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated music facility with ensemble rooms, pianos, and smaller practice rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech documents a large rehearsal room with two grand pianos, two chamber rooms, and five practice rooms at Music House; its chamber-music page explains student card access.
cards.access_notes: Student card access must be requested by email with a university ID. The cited page says reservations are not currently required, but verify before visiting.

cards.title: See Student Performance Up Close
cards.subtitle: Intimate performing-arts venue in Dabney Hall
cards.notes: Watch the PVA calendar for student concerts or performances here; attend a scheduled program rather than assuming the room is open.
cards.short_summary: A small campus performance setting used alongside Caltech’s larger auditoriums.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech Performing and Visual Arts identifies Dabney Lounge as an intimate venue where student performances are held.
cards.access_notes: Access is tied to scheduled performances or authorized activities; consult the PVA calendar or organizer for event admission and room access.

cards.title: Reset Between Work Sessions
cards.subtitle: Indoor recreation base south of the main campus core
cards.notes: Check the weekly facility schedule before gathering for exercise, then bring the credentials required by Recreation for building entry.
cards.short_summary: Caltech’s principal indoor recreation facility supports individual and group physical activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech Recreation lists Braun Athletic Center among its recreational facilities and publishes current building hours and facility schedules for community use.
cards.source_title: Recreational Facilities - California Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Published hours are Monday–Friday 6 a.m.–10 p.m. and weekends 8 a.m.–8 p.m.; consult weekly schedules and Recreation membership rules before entry.

cards.title: Trade Screens for a Climbing Session
cards.subtitle: Specialized recreation space at the Athletic Center
cards.notes: Review the facility calendar and safety requirements first, then arrange a session that matches every participant’s authorization and skill level.
cards.short_summary: A named Athletic Center facility for supervised, skill-based climbing recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s current recreational-facilities page lists the Climbing Wall and Bouldering Cave as a distinct facility with a dedicated schedule link.
cards.source_title: Recreational Facilities - California Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Use is governed by Recreation schedules, membership rules, and climbing-safety requirements. Confirm orientation or supervision requirements before arrival.

warnings: Public access varies by space. Several locations require a Caltech ID, reservation, program participation, event admission, training, or Recreation eligibility; cards preserve those restrictions.
